notes: Find Traps is entirely informational. Its effect is 'you sense any trap within range that is within line of sight' and 'the general nature of the danger posed by a trap you sense.' No attack roll, no saving throw, no damage, no condition, no stat modification. The spell produces no deterministic mechanical outcome — all results are DM-adjudicated world-state facts (what counts as a trap, what the general danger is). Per ARCHITECTURE.md, such caller-owned facts are out of scope for the core mechanics model. No valid activation phase exists: ActivationMechanics requires attack_roll or save_gate phases, and forcing an empty phases array would produce a dishonest trace.
